turns.user: I want to stop cutting and start building muscle instead

args.reason: Switching focus from fat loss to muscle growth (hypertrophy) to start building mass.

turns.user: does that change what I'm eating as well, or just the training?
turns.reply:
It changes both, Ashley. 

On the training side, we'll rebuild the rest of your block to focus on hypertrophy—adjusting the volume, rep ranges, and conditioning to prioritize building muscle. 

For your food, it's a direct shift. Since we're moving from a calorie deficit (fat loss) to a surplus or maintenance (muscle growth), your daily calorie target will go up, and your macro splits—especially your carbs and fats—will adjust to fuel that recovery and growth. 

The card on your screen shows exactly what your new daily targets and training structure will look like before you make the switch.
